PM Modi announces strict law against exam paper leaks

Prime Minister Narendra Modi released a video message announcing a new, strict law against exam paper leaks. He stated that those involved in paper leak gangs, who tamper with students' futures, will not be spared. The government is taking continuous steps against such activities. The Lok Pariksha (Amendment) Bill, which aims to curb paper leaks, has been passed by Parliament. The new law reportedly includes provisions for up to 10 years in jail and a fine of up to ₹1 crore.
